text:
nate: tiny late-night brag: midnight hotfix held and we stayed at p95 SLA. tacos for whoever can make it to the kitchen tomorrow? :taco:
lena: midnight deploy legend badge incoming. also small ukulele jam?
omar: ukulele jam is non-negotiable. i'll bring my uke and an amp :guitar:
tia: love this. poll: :taco: tacos, :uke: uke jam + cookies, :sticker: stickers only
playlist-bot: POLL: tacos 7, uke jam + cookies 12, stickers 4
deploy-bot: DEPLOY: hotfix "midnight-keepalive" succeeded at 2026-03-26T00:03Z
lena: shoutout to the keepalive toggles and the timeout bump. zero client reconnects noted :100:
omar: also shoutout to the monitoring alerts team for the quick pager response. saved bedtime
tia: i'll bake cookies. can folks confirm dietary prefs? drop emoji for gf/vegan/dairy
nate: added confetti gif and a tiny celebratory GIF of a cat typing furiously :cat_typing:
playlist-bot: Playlist suggestion: "Midnight Wins"  add songs by reacting w/ :musical_note:
lena: adding "midnight city" and "working for the weekend" :musical_note:
omar: i'll bring a tiny speaker and a ukulele chord cheat sheet
calendar-bot: Event created: "Midnight Win Tacos + Uke Jam"  Tomorrow 12:30 PM PT  #all
tia: remote folks: redeem snack stipend here https://snacks.example/redeem and i'll ship a cookie care package if you DM me address
nate: tiny plaque idea: "We shipped at midnight" for the kitchen, low-key and classy
lena: can someone take a group photo at the end and make a 10s montage?
omar: i'll handle montage, need short clips or pics from folks
tia: gratitude to infra & oncall for staying calm. you saved our sleep schedules and the product :heart:
nate: short and sweet. see you at 12:30 for tacos and ukes :tada:
